title: finding(app-shell): the agent preview's "Try in chat" link points at /console/ai/agents/NAME/chat, a path no console route declares, so it redirects home — the sibling of objectui#10591
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, read at source. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the dev report and contract review of PR objectui#10632 (objectui#10591). ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here. ⛔ Not probed in a running app.

## The defect

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.tsx` renders the metadata preview for an `agent` (Studio → agents). Its "Try in chat" link is a plain anchor, opening in a new tab:

    const chatUrl = agentName ? `/console/ai/agents/${encodeURIComponent(agentName)}/chat` : null;

No route in the console matches it. `apps/console/src/App.tsx` and `components/StudioRoute.tsx` declare no path beginning with `/console`. The chat routes are `/ai`, `/ai/:agent` and `/ai/:agent/:conversationId`, so the intended target exists. The link therefore matches only the root `path="*"` route, `RedirectWithSplash to="/"`, and lands the author on home. As a plain anchor it also ignores the router basename: the console mounts under `/_console`.

This is the same shape as objectui#10591, the tool preview's "Open in API Console" link, which PR objectui#10632 fixes by building the link inside the router.

## Evidence

- Read at source by the dev of PR objectui#10632, and confirmed by that PR's contract reviewer: the `chatUrl` template, every `path=` in the two root route tables, and the `/ai/:agent` chat routes.
- ⛔ Not measured in a running app.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The likely shape is objectui#10591's: build the link through the router (`Link`), so the basename applies, and point it at the chat route the console actually declares (`/ai/NAME`). Or, if the chat has a registry key, point it at that key inside the current app. When the preview has no router, draw no link.
- Pin: the link resolves, through the real route table, to the agent's chat page, not the catch-all.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. `AgentPreview`, "Try in chat" and `console/ai/agents` ⇒ 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `AgentPreview Try in chat` · `console/ai/agents chat link` · `agent preview chat link redirects home`
